resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code. Used with PBEsol functional and Vanderbilt ultrasoft pseudopotentials.

resources.notes: Required for DFT static energy-volume calculations.

resources.name: Gibbs2 (quasi-harmonic Debye model program)

access.notes: Open-source implementation of the QHD model. Also available at http://gibbs.webs.uvigo.es/.

resources.notes: Used to compute thermodynamic properties from the DFT E(V) data.

resources.name: LAMMPS
resources.notes: Used for NPT MD simulations with SM and BSM potentials.

resources.name: Shell-model potential parameters for MgO (Lewis & Catlow 1985)

access.notes: Paper [28] in the source. Parameters define Buckingham-type pair potentials and shell model parameters.

resources.notes: Parameter values (A, B, C, shell charges, spring constants) must be obtained from the literature.

resources.name: Breathing shell-model potential parameters for MgO (Catlow et al. 1979)

access.notes: Paper [52] in the source. Includes spring constant K_i and radius R_0 for the breathing oxygen shell.

resources.notes: Parameter values needed for MD simulations with the BSM potential.

resources.name: MgO rock-salt crystal structure

access.notes: Standard NaCl-type structure with lattice parameter ~4.21 Å. Agent can construct from known crystallographic data.

resources.notes: Starting geometry for DFT and MD simulations.

resources.name: Vanderbilt ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Mg and O (PBEsol)

access.notes: Can be obtained from the Standard Solid-State Pseudopotentials (SSSP) library or similar open repository.

resources.notes: Required for DFT calculations. Must correspond to PBEsol functional.
